items.description: Vox Populi, a Savannah Morning News feature, uses the Evoca API and a web-to-voice service to let readers call 912-652-0370 to voice an opinion and have it published on the website.
Nice integration of library data like what you have checked-out or are waiting forinto an automatically updating Google Gadget. Initially for Ann Arbor District Library. Talis mashup contest winner.
